title: Critical Risk Threshold Crossed - Valley View (H001)
message: Village Valley View (H001) has crossed the critical risk threshold with a risk score of 89.0. Immediate relocation planning initiated. Landslide risk extremely high due to saturation from recent rainfall.

title: Critical Risk Threshold Crossed - Shoreline Basti (H016)
message: Village Shoreline Basti (H016) has crossed the critical risk threshold with a risk score of 85.0. Coastal erosion rate accelerated to 2.5m/year after recent cyclone. Immediate evacuation planning required.

title: Relocation Site R-02 Limited Capacity
message: Relocation Site R-02 (Greenfield Settlement Area) has only 700 available capacity remaining. Current population at 2,800 of 3,500 total. May not accommodate planned relocations from H006, H009, H013, H019.

title: Relocation Site R-05 Near Capacity
message: Relocation Site R-05 (Riverbank Resettlement Area) has only 500 available capacity. Sanitation infrastructure incomplete. Risk of overcapacity if flood evacuations increase.

title: New Hazard Data Requires Reassessment
message: Updated geological survey data for North Ridge Landslide Zone (HZ001) indicates increased slope instability. Risk assessments for H001, H003, H007, H008, H012, H014 require updating.

title: Monsoon Forecast - Above Normal Rainfall
message: IMD forecasts above-normal monsoon rainfall for the region (110% of LPA). Increased landslide and flood risk expected. Pre-position emergency resources and review evacuation plans.

title: Field Verification Data Received - H001
message: Field survey team completed verification for Valley View (H001). Confirmed active ground movement cracks in 12 structures. Soil moisture at 92% saturation. Data uploaded to risk assessment.

title: Field Verification Data Received - H016
message: Coastal survey completed for Shoreline Basti (H016). Shoreline retreat measured at 2.3m since last survey (6 months). 5 structures now at immediate risk. Sea wall at R004 holding.

title: Capacity Assessment Updated - R003
message: Capacity assessment for Highland Refuge Camp (R003) updated. Water supply expanded to 3,500 capacity. Healthcare facility upgraded. Available capacity: 3,500.

title: Relocation Plan Draft - H001 to R001
message: Draft relocation plan prepared for Valley View (H001) to Safe Valley (R001). 1,240 population, 12.5km distance. Estimated 45 days for phased move. Budget: ₹2.8 crores.
